plan.design: Protocol A: the UNMODIFIED ARoG pipeline (NLPGM/ARoG, patched only to log prompts and set num_ctx=16384, seed) runs on the projected Synthea KG with Qwen2.5-7B-instruct; every outbound LLM prompt is logged; attackers read the log.
plan.test_sample: first 20 patients per class by sorted patient_mid of the TEST split (120 patients x L0,L1,L2 = 360 ARoG records); make_arog_data.py --limit_patients 120. Chosen before test, from time budget (~31 s/record on dev).
plan.primary_endpoint: A3_logreg (trained on TRAIN views only) accuracy on the relation-label SET parsed from relation_search_prune prompts of the real ARoG log, at L0 and L1: one-sided exact binomial vs chance 1/6, Holm over {L0, L1}; plus label-permutation control C-. L2 reported as expected null.
plan.primary_note: DEVIATION DISCLOSED: the original proposal named the zero-shot LLM attacker (A1) as primary; after dev (A1 on raw transcript ~ chance; A3 70-80% on L0/L1) A3 was made primary. A1 variants are secondary.
secondary: A1 extracted label list (xtract; ADDED AFTER observing dev A1-raw)
A1 on fixed views (Protocol B) for the same patients
A3 on fixed views of ALL 240 test patients (labelled as supplementary, not ARoG traffic)
audit: fraction of test records whose transcript label set == fixed-view label set
attackers_tried_on_dev: A1 zero-shot Qwen2.5-7B on raw transcript
A3 centroid / logreg on counts (fixed views)
A3 centroid / logreg on label presence (transcripts)
plan.controls_gate: C+ accuracy on DEV >= 0.90 and parse rate >= 0.95 before any test run (met on dev: C+ L1 = 1.000, parse 1.0)
plan.counting: unparsable answer = wrong; parse rate reported; transcripts truncated at 40000 chars are counted and reported
plan.claim_rule: 'ARoG leaks' may be written only if the primary endpoint rejects chance at L0 or L1 after Holm; wording must be scoped to this setup (Synthea, 6-class closed world, Qwen2.5-7B, ARoG as released, v2.1 relation mapping); never 'first' or 'general'.
plan.threat_model: honest-but-curious remote party sees all outbound prompts (stage=ALL, conservative); stage ablations reported
plan.disclosure: test split is not prospectively pristine (D2 exploratory exposure); dev/train used for design only; relation mapping v2.1 is operational, not clinically validated; Synthea module structure makes labels informative by construction
